name: Generic plasma table (G-code)
_comment: G-code for a plasma table. G21/G90 select millimetres and absolute moves; G94 is feed per minute. The 1.5 mm kerf is the full cut width: the post-processor's caller offsets outer contours outward and holes inward by half of it. A real machine needs its own pierce height, cut height and feed in the header, and a lead-in long enough to keep the pierce crater off the part; both are machine and material settings this profile does not guess.
